options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (date range, days with values, total, highest and lowest days, non-working days and holidays).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for day values (tooltips, accessible names, legend, table, summary).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Shared chart option; a calendar heatmap has no series, so it has no effect.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash?; axisColor?; lineWidth?; markerSize?; cornerRadius?; barRadius?; cellRadius?; sliceRadius?; boxRadius?; swatchRadius?; tooltipRadius?; controlRadius?; lineJoin?; areaOpacity?; gradient?; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the highlight and tooltip at the same column (week index) when one is hovered or focused.

options.name: data
options.description: Days: { date: PlainDate; value: number | null } (null, NaN, and infinities are days without value; later duplicates replace earlier ones). At most 20,000 entries.

options.name: year
options.description: Show this calendar year (ignored when from and to are both set).

options.name: from
options.description: First day shown (inclusive). Default: January 1 of year, else the first data date.

options.name: to
options.description: Last day shown (inclusive), at most 1,097 days after from. Default: December 31 of year, else the last data date.

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First row: ISO weekday 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). Default: from the locale (getFirstDayOfWeek).

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Business calendar (createBusinessCalendar from @absoluteui/components/business-calendar): non-working days are outlined, holidays get a dot and their name in tooltips, accessible names, and the table.

options.name: colorScale
options.description: { color?: 1-8 (default 1), min?, max? (fixed domain; default the nice-rounded data extent), steps?: 3-9 (default 5) }. Values outside a fixed domain use the first or last step.

options.name: legend
options.description: Legend of the color steps with their ranges, "No value", and (with a business calendar) the non-working-day and holiday keys; auto and show both show it, hide removes it. Entries are not buttons.

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback (one row per day: date, value, and (with a business calendar) the day type): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

options.name: patterns
options.description: Shared chart option (toggles aui-chart--patterns); day squares are not textured, so it has no visible effect.

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: monthLabels
options.description: Month names above the first week of each month.

options.name: weekdayLabels
options.description: Weekday names beside the rows: auto (every other row), all, or none.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, date, and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl puts the first week on the right and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same mark.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; no effect beyond a re-render.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, timers, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: CalendarHeatmapPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A day was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused day. label is the formatted date, column the week, row the weekday row, value the formatted value.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar-heatmap
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title, description, and the toolbar (zoom buttons).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip--custom / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-row
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused mark carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty / __summary
cssClasses.description: Empty state text and the hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar-heatmap__cells / __cell / __cell--empty
cssClasses.description: Day squares (focusable marks) and days without value.

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar-heatmap__cell--off / __cell--holiday
cssClasses.description: Non-working days (dashed outline) and holidays (business calendar).

cssClasses.name: aui-calendar-heatmap__swatch-empty / __swatch-off / __swatch-holiday
cssClasses.description: Legend keys for days without value, non-working days, and holidays.
